name: People First
description: Survivors with inner lives, memories, and each other, living in a world that keeps moving when you're not looking.  They bond, fall in love, marry and raise children, and make homes of their own.  Build a home that grows into a town, or travel with a band and move in with them.  Open the People menu with the comma key to see it all.  Pair with People First: Engine on the patched build for the full experience.
